businessModel: Ad-funded: news feed, sponsored content and search/partner revenue on Xiaomi phones

summary: Mi Browser is the default browser on Xiaomi phones, available as Mi Browser Pro on Google Play and as a built-in Xiaomi Browser. Includes ad blocker and night mode, but also feeds, sponsored content and a 2020 incognito-tracking scandal.
bestFor: Xiaomi owners wanting the stock browser
Users who want a light mobile browser with night mode
notFor: Users who dislike ads and recommended content

pros.detail: Comes with Xiaomi devices; modest resource use.

pros.title: Night mode and reading tools
pros.detail: Dark mode, video download and reader tools in app.

cons.title: Ads and feeds
cons.detail: HyperOS guides list Mi Browser among apps showing ads, recommended news and sponsored content.

cons.title: 2020 incognito tracking
cons.detail: Forbes reported Mi Browser/Pro recorded private browsing; Xiaomi added an opt-out toggle.

cons.title: Xiaomi-only polish
cons.detail: Tightly tied to Xiaomi system services.

faq.q: What happened with Mi Browser and incognito mode?
faq.a: In April 2020 Forbes reported Mi Browser and Mi Browser Pro sent browsing data, including incognito, to Xiaomi servers; Xiaomi added an opt-out button by May 4, 2020.

faq.q: How do I disable ads in Mi Browser?
faq.a: Turn off Show ads, recommended news and personalised services in Mi Browser settings, and disable MSA/personalised ads in system Privacy settings.
